blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Brooke Van Sickle had to watch from the sidelines when Nxled made history without her with a breakthrough silver-medal finish in the Premier Volleyball League Invitational Conference. The three-time league Conference MVP was recovering from a shoulder injury that made her miss the PVL on Tour and the Invitational, where her team faced Thai club EST Cola. Now back on the court, Van Sickle is eager to contribute to Nxled’s rise, scoring 11 points in sweeping PLDT, 25-16, 25-20, 25-18, in the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at the Smart Araneta Coliseum. “It’s really good to be […]...
